correctness.rationale: For these SL4 matrix groups the no-pseudo-reflection lemma applies, so Benson's canonical class-group theorem reduces the groups to character duals. Exact exhaustive group multiplication and normal commutator closures yield group/derived orders (36/9,24/6,288/32,576/288) with complete quotient-order distributions, confirming C2²,C2²,C3²,C2. The additional generator F is outside G65, squares inside it, and conjugates every G65 generator to its inverse modulo the derived group, yielding index-two quasi-étale cover and inversion action. Natural character restriction forces zero pullback. All matrices and these finite statements were checked with packaged code.

value.rationale: Divisor-class torsion is the exact Q-Cartier obstruction for the four highly motivated complete-intersection counterexamples to a crepant-resolution conjecture. The finite double cover between cases 65 and 66 displays a geometrically meaningful nontrivial torsion change (2-torsion downstairs versus inversion-acted 3-torsion upstairs) and trivial pullback. This is a coherent exact invariant and descent computation, not an arbitrary parameter slice, and supplies data for quotient and birational geometry even though it does not establish a broader theorem.
